bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; prohibiting the use of appropriations from the clean water fund, the parks and trails fund, and the arts and cultural heritage fund from being used to acquire property through eminent domain; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, sections 85.53, by adding a subdivision; 114D.50, by adding a subdivision; 129D.17, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 85.53, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 8.+]

[+Eminent domain prohibited.+]

[+Money appropriated from the parks and trails fund must not be spent to acquire property by eminent domain unless the owner requests that the owner's property be acquired by eminent domain. +]

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 114D.50, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 8.+]

[+Eminent domain prohibited.+]

[+Money appropriated from the clean water fund must not be spent to acquire property by eminent domain unless the owner requests that the owner's property be acquired by eminent domain. +]

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 129D.17, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 7.+]

[+Eminent domain prohibited.+]

[+Money appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund must not be spent to acquire property by eminent domain unless the owner requests that the owner's property be acquired by eminent domain. +]
